findings: Original32cases control icon/overlay/arrow/frame flags from unavailable mask, panel-open and animation inputs. Virtual setters capture booleans; native branches executed unchanged.

Eight source ShadowIslesEvolutionBar arrows/frames preserve native atlas, UVs, rectangles, color and layers. At level1 three eligible buttons drawn; R absent. After E learning point exhaustion hides all arrows/frames.

Server progression and client eligibility share next_rank; existing431core tests pass. No generic champion progression invented: only implemented Annie/Garen schemes accepted. Invalid rank overflow returns explicit error.

Normal pointer path selects a rendered frame, emits ordinary sequence-numbered Learn UDP command and receives authoritative learned rank. Graphical probe queues one synthetic logical cursor at E frame center through that same selection/emission path, not direct Learn dispatch in probe.
Actual baseline and post-learning screenshots inspected Vulkan/DX12; server/core source rebuilt for both executable runs.
limits: Native unavailable-mask producer, open-state/fade/glow, expanded-panel animation, hover highlighting, tooltip, original click callbacks and full native-framebuffer identity remain open.

Graphical clicks are synthetic cursor requests in the qualification probe. OS/native mouse events not exercised; standalone unit checks cover real UDP packet transport, point gating/edges and server learning rejection after point exhaustion.

Only AnnieE level1 observed graphically; Garen, higher ranks, R, unsupported champion schemes, resize/fullscreen/DPI and all input policies remain unqualified. Rendered frame rectangles supply pointer boxes; native exact hit semantics not proven.
All24domains remain unclosed. Full HUD, map, champion kits, multiplayer match, launcher/services and autonomous package acceptance remain open.
